set.body: Found in independent review of the scale-invariant motion solve (bd-01KXYJPWYV08VFWRMCYYDPZCAV, commit on branch motion/scale-invariant-solve-20260930). MotionControl huberK = 1.5 is in absolute intensity units (used in MotionEstimator robust weights), so the robust estimator is not intensity-scale invariant: reviewer probe with 0.6/1.4-voxel shifts found rz 0.0189 vs 0.0345 (clean, scale 1 vs 1e3), tx 0.776 vs 0.748 (noisy), tx 1.424 vs 1.321 (large shift). Scope: define huberK relative to a declared residual scale (e.g. MAD of residuals within the mask, per level/iteration or per frame), document the estimand change, add intensity-scale invariance tests with Huber active (scales 1e-6..1e6), and re-run VolreggerParitySuite; decide whether parity with volregger (absolute threshold) must be preserved or deliberately migrated. Also: 'if !accepted then levelConverged = true' reports a line-search failure after 6 halvings as convergence; decide and test. The robust-template MAD floor 1e-12 (MotionEstimator robust template) is in cost units and matters only at very low intensities.
set.title: Motion: make the robust Huber threshold relative to a residual scale
